tagline: Colonial Fort Kochi, Kathakali nights and backwater day trips to Alleppey
signatureFood: Kerala sadya, appam with stew, karimeen pollichathu, prawn roast, banana chips

seasons.label: Cool and dry
seasons.note: Best weather for sightseeing and backwater cruises.

seasons.label: Hot and humid
seasons.note: Hot and sticky; schedule outdoor visits early or late.

seasons.label: Monsoon
seasons.note: Heavy rain with green landscapes; backwater cruises may be restricted and outdoor plans disrupted.

places.name: Chinese Fishing Nets at Fort Kochi
places.desc: Cantilevered fishing nets on the Fort Kochi waterfront, best at sunset with fresh-catch stalls nearby.

places.name: Mattancherry (Dutch) Palace
places.desc: 16th-century Portuguese-built palace with Kerala murals depicting Hindu epics and Kochi royal artefacts.

places.name: Paradesi Synagogue and Jew Town
places.desc: India's oldest active synagogue (1568), surrounded by antique shops and spice warehouses.

places.name: Kathakali Performance with Makeup Demo
places.desc: Traditional dance-drama preceded by a make-up demonstration, held in the early evening.

places.name: Alleppey Backwater Cruise Day Trip
places.desc: Day trip to Alleppey for a shared houseboat or canoe cruise through palm-fringed canals, with a Kerala lunch; about 1.5 hours each way.

places.name: Marine Drive Promenade
places.desc: Backwater-front promenade with sunset views and evening street snacks.

places.name: Lulu Mall
places.desc: One of India's largest malls with shops, a food court and entertainment; handy on a rainy day.

places.name: Traditional Kerala Sadya Lunch
places.desc: Multi-course vegetarian feast served on a banana leaf, with payasam and local sides.

places.name: St. Francis Church
places.desc: One of India's oldest European-built churches, where Vasco da Gama was first buried.

places.name: Ayurvedic Massage Session
places.desc: Traditional abhyanga massage by trained therapists; a relaxing break between sightseeing.

places.name: Bolgatty Island Palace Walk
places.desc: Small island with a Dutch-built palace, lawns and a short ferry ride from Ernakulam.
